datasets.name: ds_adv
queryLines: SELECT `Advertiser` AS advertiser, `Category` AS category, `Region` AS region, `Risk Tier` AS risk_tier,        `Renewal Window` AS renewal_window, `Days to Renewal` AS days_to_renewal, `Recommended Action` AS recommended_action,        MEASURE(`Revenue at Risk`) AS revenue_at_risk, MEASURE(`Total Contract Value`) AS contract_value,        MEASURE(`Avg Renewal Risk Score`) AS risk_score, MEASURE(`Avg Delivery Risk Score`) AS delivery_score,        MEASURE(`Avg Audience Risk Score`) AS audience_score, MEASURE(`Avg Renewal Urgency Score`) AS urgency_score,        CASE WHEN `Risk Tier`='High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_high,        CASE WHEN `Renewal Window`='renews_this_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_tq,        CASE WHEN `Risk Tier`='High' AND `Renewal Window`='renews_this_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_act_today FROM mv_advertiser_renewal GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

datasets.name: ds_camp
queryLines: SELECT advertiser_name AS advertiser, campaign_id, category, campaign_pacing_ratio, delivery_status,        booked_spend, reach_delivery_ratio, in_target_pct, audience_quality_score,        nielsen_is_stale, nielsen_lag_hours, adserver_lag_hours FROM gold_campaign_delivery

datasets.name: ds_silver_accounts
queryLines:
SELECT
  advertiser_id,
  advertiser_name,
  category,
  region,
  account_owner,
  source_system,
  last_refresh,
  _ingested_at
FROM
  ad_sales_demo.ad_sales.silver_accounts

datasets.name: ds_silver_deals
queryLines:
SELECT
  deal_id,
  advertiser_id,
  stage,
  contract_value,
  deal_start,
  deal_end,
  renewal_date,
  upfront_commit_flag,
  renewal_window,
  source_system,
  last_refresh,
  _ingested_at,
  days_to_renewal
FROM
  ad_sales_demo.ad_sales.silver_deals

datasets.name: ds_silver_nielsen
queryLines:
SELECT
  campaign_id,
  advertiser_id,
  target_demo,
  planned_reach,
  delivered_reach,
  reach_delivery_ratio,
  gross_rating_points,
  target_audience_impressions,
  in_target_pct,
  avg_frequency,
  audience_quality_score,
  source_system,
  last_refresh,
  _ingested_at,
  _source_file
FROM
  ad_sales_demo.ad_sales.silver_nielsen

datasets.name: ds_ml_risk
queryLines: SELECT advertiser_name, category, region, risk_tier, renewal_window, days_to_renewal, p_churn, adv_shortfall_risk, renewal_risk_score, delivery_risk_score, audience_risk_score, renewal_urgency_score, revenue_at_risk, total_contract_value, recommended_action FROM advertiser_risk_scores

datasets.name: ds_ml_decomp
queryLines: WITH top AS (SELECT advertiser_name, p_churn, adv_shortfall_risk, renewal_urgency_score, revenue_at_risk FROM advertiser_risk_scores WHERE risk_tier='High' ORDER BY revenue_at_risk DESC LIMIT 15) SELECT advertiser_name, driver, contribution FROM top LATERAL VIEW stack(3, 'Churn', 45*p_churn, 'Delivery', 35*adv_shortfall_risk, 'Urgency', 0.2*renewal_urgency_score) t AS driver, contribution

datasets.name: ds_ml_monitor_wide
queryLines: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN model='delivery_shortfall_model' AND metric='auc' THEN value END) AS auc_delivery, MAX(CASE WHEN model='renewal_risk_model' AND metric='auc' THEN value END) AS auc_renewal FROM ml_model_monitoring

datasets.name: ds_ml_rates
queryLines: SELECT model, CASE WHEN metric LIKE 'predicted%' THEN 'Predicted' ELSE 'Actual' END AS kind, value AS rate FROM ml_model_monitoring WHERE metric LIKE '%rate'

datasets.name: ds_ml_campshort
queryLines: SELECT s.campaign_id, c.advertiser_name, c.category, s.p_shortfall, s.under_delivered, c.booked_spend, c.delivery_status FROM ml_campaign_shortfall_scores s JOIN gold_campaign_delivery c ON s.campaign_id=c.campaign_id

Both models are logged in MLflow and registered in Unity Catalog, batch-scored and monitored predicted-vs-actual. Delivery-shortfall has real labels; renewal-risk is a v1 on limited history.
